about: Review notes on the UI redesign mockups of the WGSExtract/wgsextract-cli repository (https://github.com/WGSExtract/wgsextract-cli). The mockups are static HTML, CSS and JavaScript in gui/mockups/ on branch main. This file holds the notes for one mockup page. Fields: "page" is the page id: <direction>-<name> is gui/mockups/directions/<direction>/<name>.html (for example c-home is directions/c/home.html); index, design-system and icons are gui/mockups/index.html, design-system/design-system.html and icons/icons.html. "notes" maps note ids to notes. In a note, anchor.annot is the data-annot-id of the element the note is pinned to (anchor.path is a CSS path below that element, x, y, w and h are fractions of its box, and a null anchor means the whole page); author is who wrote it; text is the note; status is open or resolved; replies is the thread; context is the viewport, theme and Basic/Advanced level it was written in. To act on the notes: read gui/mockups/README.md and gui/mockups/DESIGN.md first; for each open note, change the mockup HTML, CSS or the design system (gui/mockups/design-system/) to address it, keeping the design system consistent across pages; then add a reply with author "AI" whose text starts with "(AI):" and says what changed, and set status to resolved (or leave it open and ask a question in the reply). Keep the file's format (sorted keys, two-space indent) and check it with python3 gui/mockups/serve.py --check.
